reviews.text: 怎么感觉难度比demo高太多了，我都很胡了，还是过不了第2个难度…… 而且多了这么多掉落物，那重置次数就得跟上啊，这游戏数值感觉填的太随意了，拖累了有趣的玩法。
不怎么样，随机性太高反而会玩的不舒服。起码要可以调整球发射的方向吧，就连发射方向都是随机的，导致玩起来很别扭，不过撞针和遗物互相搭配起来撞的很爽就是了。商店页面宣传片的BGM很好听也很解压但是玩起来并没有这个BGM也挺遗憾的
玩着很上头，但设计有很多不合理的 和幸运房东流程一样是要在规定轮次内攒够钱，但每次上供之后钱会清零而不是继承，就算你前几轮运气好攒了很多钱，一次上供之后钱就全没了，新的轮次运气差一些很容易就输了。 整个过程随机性太强，太靠运气，操作空间很少，有点难受。
游戏很好， 我邻居家的孩子很喜欢，玩的很沉迷。 她家老公一上班， 她孩子玩游戏就没人管了， 她就可以在卧室和我深入交流了。
很有意思的游戏，能体会到成天打柏青哥的废人乐趣
优点：玩法较为新颖，道具种类丰富，地图多样 缺点：随机性过强（疑似有算法检测），流派构建困难，流派深度低且同质化，高难度数值设计不合理
i just like the vibes man, the funny dancing stick-figure that says "Wow!" every time i pick a new upgrade, they motivate me. I appreciate them so much especially after a long day of work.

Great fun! Only problem is, once a build gets optimized, everything just explodes every time I drop a ball. Game seems to stutter hard whenever a build gets too optimized/overblown. It's fun, it's stupid, but my pc crie.

差评是为了让官方看到，这游戏如果你完成一个场上无限，那么你这局就已经结束了，因为你无法结算，我在靠厨师帽和鱼桶以及扭转生产者重力上靠着砖块和生产水球火球导致了场上永远有球在触发

Have you ever dreamed of playing a roguelike version of Plinko from the price is right? Yeah me neither, but this game is the perfect example of "just one more game". It balances difficulty with unlocks at a rate that makes you want to keep going.

Love the presentation, the art, the dancing stickmen. I feel like it almost works, but I feel severely lacking in agency. If I'm doing well, I don't feel like it's my fault. If I lose, I also don't feel like I had any influence on it. It could just be that Pachinko as a core concept is not something that is any fun to me. Peglin, a very similar game, has the benefit of Peggle already just being fun before you introduce the Roguelite elements. Ballionaire has the uphill battle of taking a concept that isn't any fun and adding gameplay to it. I've had my moments playing it. Maybe about 5 minutes of my hour of playtime had me grinning and feeling like I did something right, but then for some reason it would just stop working and I lose.
难是真的不难，打了两三局就能连续通关了，像杀戮尖塔，小丑牌最低难度玩明白通关怎么也得10局左右。目前就是感觉池子有点浅，未来可期。

《弹球亿万富翁》是一款柏青哥下落式弹球结合肉鸽元素的休闲游戏。游戏任务玩家需要在下落式的弹球的游戏中通过碰触各种机关来获得金钱，并在每个关卡中上贡相应的进件来完成上供，从而不断的推进关卡来上贡越来越多的金钱 [h2] 制定策略获得更高的金钱 [/h2] 本作游戏还是相当考验玩家的策略，玩家需要为筹集目标金钱而不断改善自己的面板，当玩家完成了一轮上贡之后，就可以在三张卡牌中选择一张，放置到面板上的空白位置，以便将未来的小球下落的时候可以得到更多的加成。不同的卡牌可以有不同的效果，有一些卡牌可以制作出炸裂的加成。如果三张卡牌没有想要的内容，可以选择重掷。但是重掷的次数是有限的，可以通过完成章节来获得额外的次数。尤其是非常考验玩家的头脑的，其实到了后期一些组合可以让小球在场上存活很长的时间并不断生成新的小球，从而赚取非常多的金钱。而如果玩家没有制定好策略，那么小球可能只获得几百块钱就下落到最下面了 [h2] 游戏也需要一定的运气成分 [/h2] 很多游戏不光考验的是玩家的策略，也考验一些运气成分，小球初始往哪个方向以及某些物理特性能够将小球弹到多远，都是比较考验玩家的运气的，毕竟这种柏青哥游戏机就很考验运气，有赌博的成分。所以玩家要做的就是尽可能在多个方向完善自己的策略，并能够让小球无论从哪个方向下来都有足够的机会能够获得一定的金钱 你可以在小球的下方设置一些其他小球的生成方式来规避一些默认小球产生的失误，让玩家收获的金钱能够更高一些。当场上的设施足够丰富，每一次开始游戏的时候，整个场上会各种碰撞，各种爆炸，各种效果眼花缭乱，并且满屏幕的数字让人看上去非常爽。游戏的前期可能效果并不是那么明显，但是游戏到了后期，如果玩家还能够存活的话，那么场上的效果是非常炸裂的 [h2] 多种模式提供给玩家 [/h2] 本次游戏的核心玩法就是上面的玩法，除了常规的玩法之外，游戏还提供了一些自定义玩法和实验室玩法，能够让玩家脱离默认规则的枷锁，自由自在的制定规则体验爽快的下落小球玩法 游戏的价格也不高，比起去现实体验那种赌博输钱，不如在电脑上狂轰滥炸一番
最后一关这个弹珠的物理引擎给我玩笑了，做好点再拿出来吧

[h1]当肉鸽再次遇上弹球！[/h1] 似乎从Pocketpair制作组画饼般的推出了究极缝合作品《创世幻想乡》之后，似乎缝合这个词不仅进入了玩家的视野，也进入了一众厂商的视野，而在缝合游戏之中肉鸽元素似乎成为最为好用的一块砖，哪里需要哪里帮，从一开始的卡牌到国际象棋再到弹珠，似乎没有一个题材不能和肉鸽所融合。而今天的主角就是与《哥布林弹球》玩法完全相反的肉鸽弹球新作。 [h1][quote=] [table] [tr] [th] 欢迎关注 [b][u][i]U_U鉴赏家培养计划[/i][/u][/b][/th] [/tr] [tr] [th] 关注U_U鉴赏家，开启精彩游戏之旅。 [/th] [/tr] [/table] [/quote][/h1] [h1]特别好评肉鸽游戏《哥布林弹球》同类作品，但是却选择了不同的道路[/h1] 其实在本作之前已经有一些作品开始尝试将肉鸽和弹珠相融合，而《哥布林弹球》显然就是其中的佼佼者，评价书高达一万三千多，整体评价特别好评都再展现着这款游戏的不俗，但是《哥布林弹球》中肉鸽部分内容更多的只是在弹球上出现，但是在这款游戏之后推出的《弹球亿万富翁》则选择了另外一条完全不同的道路。 在本作当中，构成游戏肉鸽主要的内容不再是从上方落下的弹珠，反而变成了游戏中弹球碰撞的各种障碍物。游戏中不同的障碍物有着不同的效果，有的是需要碰到之后触发金钱，有的是数个放置在一起机会带来特定的效果，有的则是需要等待数回合不被碰撞之后则会进行变身，而更是有着构成肉鸽游戏中build的不同道具之间的联动，可以说制作组所设计的超过125种“触发器”（也就是上面所说的障碍物）和超过50种带来增益效果的道具为这款游戏带来了非常多样的选择。 游戏中玩家除了每一回合之后选择不同的道具之外，玩家在游戏中唯一能做的就是合理的规划不同的触发器的位置，然后根据一些触发器的特性来安排其不同的位置，一些需要时间成长的因为成长之后的特性可能既不能放置在太过偏远的地方，也不能放置在太过容易被碰到的地方，以防还没成长就早早夭折，同时一些会带来回忆的道具更是需要摆在一些必经之路上，也可以通过这些道具来设计一条方便弹球行走的路线。但是除了这些触发器的摆放之外，弹球落下的过程中玩家既不能选择其下落的反向，也不能在下落过程中做出一些改变，和前面所说的《哥布林弹球》还是有着明显的差别。 [h1]庞大的build之下的繁琐，缺失详细简介带来的稍显逊色的体验[/h1] 说完了游戏的独特之处，当然也要说一说游戏的缺点，首先就是游戏的简介和教程做的并不完整，游戏中很多道具制作组并没有说清楚其用途，笔者也是一局游戏玩完才知道游戏中的这些摆放的障碍物叫做触发器，同时一些道具的特殊名词制作组并没有给出解释，玩家经常会看着每回合需要自己选择的道具开始懵逼，不知道选哪个才好。 当然可能一些玩家会觉得大部分的同类型肉鸽游戏种都没有这些细致入微的教程之类的东西，但是本作相较于《哥布林弹球》、《幸运房东》等一众需要玩家操作较少的游戏来说，玩家需要构筑的build选项太多，构筑的场景布局也较大，所以当游戏没有上面的详细的介绍和教程之时，游戏前期的体验就大幅度下降。同时游戏种有着抽奖扭蛋选项，如果选择不合玩家心意，此时如果使用UU加速器自带的云存档功能就能轻松解决这个问题，直接一键储存当前流程之下的云存档，直接完美解决这个问题。
不是说游戏不好 但是分数清零对构筑的限制太大，而且完全不有趣，纯属败笔，不得不给差评 评价为：一颗老鼠屎，坏了一锅粥

玩着很上头，不过个人来讲有个致命缺点每轮次结算之后钱会清零而不是继承，就算你前几轮运气好攒了很多钱，一次结算之后钱就全没了，新的轮次运气差一些很容易就输了。 整个过程随机性太强，弹珠掉落方向也是纯随机，导致本该爽的游戏爽不起来。

The game is interesting, but the more you play the worse it gets and I'll elaborate on that: Making any build quickly becomes an absolute RNG hell because you have no redundancy in the items offered and very, very few ways to actually replicate any of the pieces you got, so you really are at RNGs mercy and the more items you unlock, the wrose it gets. Second thing is, once you reach the the part where the game has "Tribulations", which are basically negative passive effects, the game becomes an absolute chore, becuase these tribulations are absolutely brutal and unfun to play around. Good concept, good execution, but maybe not playtested enough? I don't know, I feel like there's a great game here but the game itself isn't letting me play it in an actual fun way. The devs giving generic canned responses to the negative reviews doesn't really help the way I feel either when any criticism to the game design is met with "Thank you for trying our game!!! We're sorry you didn't like it :(((". F#%k off with that. Either address what is being said or just shut up. This isn't a Helpdesk inbox, it's a review section. Ultimately, you'll see that most reviews are positive because a lot of them barely played more than 1 ~ 3 hours. Because that's the timeframe in which the game is fun. After that, you start to realize that basically nothing is viable and you have very little control over your build. If you're satisfied with a 2~3 hour game, it's a good novelty. If you're looking for something more long term like Slay The Spire or Balatro, stay away.

可能赌博内核的游戏对我来说都不够好玩，比如⚪神和这个游戏。某种把一切交给随机性的体验，以及将“数字的增大”视作玩法上的唯一目标。 玩家对系统的干预程度无法达到某个必要的下限，因为随机性太强了。本身的策略要素并不有趣，除了依赖于落球的运气之外，也很吃抽卡的运气。虽然抽卡会尽量给玩家关键词相近的，但是依旧很蠢。也许是同一个关键词实际上属于不同流派的物品大量存在。 总之在赌博内核带来的偌大随机性之余，策略部分也没有很好的展现。 绝对不行。 它的趣味性很大程度上其实是自我挑战，一种很高级的快乐，拿到多少钱可以破关，诸如此类。 但其实对我们这种低级玩家来说更具有吸引力的其实是破关之后抽取新的物品，然后找到新套路，循环到下一局游戏里的回路。非常遗憾的是差不多五个小时后就解锁全物品了，才刚刚打到第二个难度的第二个初始剧本。于是再多玩四个小时我就擅自视作已经完全品鉴这个游戏了，我是不觉得这种游戏低难度和高难度在核心体验上会有什么区别，无非是考验脑力和对系统的掌握度。遗憾。 另外除了金字塔模式其他模式都是半成品和垃圾。 全部售价都在金字塔里。
游戏性不错，但抽牌过于随机，特别是商店解锁了所有卡牌后反而变得更加困难了，这游戏居然没有对卡池限制的设定，解锁后卡池里的牌又多又杂，开好几把都构建不出一个流派，很难爽玩一把
不建议买，随机性太高，爽不起来
千万不要解锁太多卡牌，会污染卡池，解锁完之后很难刷到同一个流派的东西，很小概率才能刷到合适的物品组成流派，真就是戒赌了

前6-8个小时是蜜月期，非常好玩 推荐新手水上乐园开局，然后水坝正下方左右各一个鲸鱼，就能感受到这个游戏的心流了非常上头 本人是在5小时左右玩到一把咒语流，解锁了单局电脑卡死、单局超过10E刀等等极限成就（这个流派非常的不平衡，后期有大量的垃圾时间，但第一次玩到是很震撼的） 8小时后有点无聊了，平衡性太差，基本上所有乘算的加成触发器都不平衡，点名温室（搭配跨接线插座电池封箱带），左脚踩右脚，叠到400层+后面钱会超阈值崩溃 中间玩过食物流、金币流、农作流等等，都不稳定且乐趣一般，有很多设计瑕疵点，甚至还会被长老负面针对 比如农作流，运气不好本来养好的四叶草区被割成树木或者仙人掌是真的要恶心死（虽然也能过吧，温室无敌） 还有食物流，沃尔玛每次上贡清空是人能想出来的设计？你可以每个携带物给的少一点，但凭什么清空？ 在15小时发现了橱柜流，最高难度下巨无聊的稳定通关且不卡的方式（选择囤积者开局，前期只填橱柜，找口哨，口哨在一个不会被球碰到区域围一圈，然后用封箱带把橱柜挪过去，然后一直填橱柜到过关；口哨可以替换为任何乘算加成的触发器），完全不挑图，一球流，全图只有橱柜+围橱柜的一圈加成器 橱柜流极致简单到完全不需要任何操作和运气，也没有任何长老负面针对他 然后就弃坑了，等待官方调平衡吧。至少把乘算给调整一下

I do not like that this game tries to play itself off as a roguelike strategy game. It is a fun game, but let’s be very clear that this game is a gambling game. I would be very hesitant to recommend it to anyone, no matter how fun, because it is a GAMBLING GAME
奶奶的 就喜欢和随机数硬磕——我这辈子也是有了

After playing the game more I can now confidently say that I am not impressed with the item bloat. I love the choices that are found in the game, but there are so many combos that just do not work at all and filling your board with them randomly adds near zero value to your rounds. I do not like the game-play of just mashing reroll until I get something of some value. The game feels like you are experiencing "feast-or-famine". You either get some synergies that are so over-tuned you are able to easily carry most runs, or you get a random assortment of garbage and lose. I actually really like the game overall, but I can't recommend this to anyone because I feel that the developers really missed on a key component of rogue-lite design. There is no agency when it comes to your builds or items choices, just reroll. There has also been no response from the devs on what they plan to do (if anything) about this choice.

look, it's a good game, but the devs need to grow a spine and tell the guy who insisted on the dancing stick figure to go ♥♥♥♥ himself. it ruins the vibe every time it pops up (every time you get a boon, i.e. minimum 9 times per successful run), sexually harasses you on the main menu, invades my personal space at the end of every run, and just generally stains the whole game with its godless gyrations. please remove it please.
作为一个很吃运气的游戏来说，爽的门槛实在是太高了，整个游玩体验可以用憋屈来形容。比不了哥布林弹球一点。
金字塔地图什么都没放结果弹珠开局给我崩地图外面三次，我喜欢你，我杀了你

played the game for 22 hours and have 100%'d it. If youre looking to just have casual fun and this is on sale, I say go for it. Let me start with the game definitely has the potential to be pretty good but until the community (via steam workshop) or the developer makes the game have more depth to it via more/better items that inspire you to try and build for, I cant recommend purchasing this game versus competitors that are cheaper with more depth. This part of the review is about the different boards you get to play on (for context all under a ballionaire++ perspective) The board variety seems to be extremely lacking where ironically enough Pyramid happens to be the best map which is extremely disapointing when majority of players start with it and expect boards of similar skill levels in the future just to be greeted with abominations like pinballionaire. Pinballionaire is a very cool concept but the amount of builds you can legitimately make work is SO limiting, it completely destroys the replayablity of the board versus the 100 runs on pyramid or sewers/dangerwheel that you can do. Sewers/Dangerwheel are both similar in that I think they are 'easier' board layouts but I believe there can be a middle ground between ease and unique mechanics in which they both handle very well. Slotmachine this is the dedicated 'easy map' its very difficult to lose a run with the near guarenteed bonuses that the map provides onto you, if there was a possiblity for the slot machine to actually negatively impact you via mult reduction or balance removal it would add an additional element besides playing "normal pinballionaire or getting a free bonus effect on drop" Fishing, this 10000% feels like the developer trying to include a board thats just a rectangle instead of a pyramid with the only caveat being adding a pull back to the initial ball but the strongest strategy to the board is ball generation to completely ignore that feature, what are we fishing for if the only goal is to hit the triggers that are bumped from the bottom-up. The soundtrack is pretty good! TLDR: If youre seeking depth and replayability I would look elsewhere unless the game is on sale for $5 but for $12 it should be labeled as early access.

优点： 1. 个人对弹球机制、类rogue、牌组构建都比较偏爱，这些结合在一起呈现出来的玩法还是不错的。 2. 表现很好，动画表现、大数字结算、震屏、音乐音效特效，都恰到好处，非常经典有效的手段来传达爽感，bulid成型后看动画发呆也很爽。 缺点也挺明显的： 1. 不同的关卡主要是地图和debuff的设计不同，设计比较简单，比较单调，虽然开了新关卡，但并没有提供新的体验。可以考虑引入一些更复杂的机制，比如加入一些气流来影响弹道、加入阻力等等。 2. 难度曲线有待优化，前期太容易，后期难度迅速提高。负面体验有点强。 3. 在确定build方向后，单个回合的收益太高了，结合上一点，在build成型前的体验就比较枯燥了。 4. 上贡清零需要额外收益，结合上一点，用于提供额外资源的获取途径。 5. build成型后，由于单回合内触发器的数值大部分不会继承，而增益带来的数值收益也不多，导致单回合的数值上限相对有限，数值校验也就不能设置太多。某种角度而言也比较乏味了。也比较需要引入其他的随机事件来增加难度。

This is one of those games where the binary rating system makes it difficult to decide how to rate the game. Ultimately I'm giving it a thumbs up, but it I'm also not necessarily recommending this game. This is a "rogue-like" where you are building up the bumpers in a pachinko board to achieve higher and higher scores in successive rounds. There are an enormous variety of bumper types. There are themes you can work within, and a variety of strategies to employ towards getting those big numbers. The thing is, I never felt like anyone one strategy was more successful than another. In fact, you'd almost need to try to do poorly. Pretty much any combination you throw at the board is going to work on the lower difficulty levels, and on higher difficulty levels you are going to combat RNG more than any particular problem with your board setup. Ballionaire is a fine diversion for a 30 minute break, but not something I'm going to get feverish about like Balatro.

Ballionaire is wildly addicting and knows how to implement visual and audio feedback to give you them good chemicals whenever you get a multi-minute long combo going. While the game has it's hooks in you, it's a real joy in figuring out synergies and playstyles but unfortunately after the discovery period is through, actually implementing what you've learned makes this game pretty easy. In reality there are about 5 or so playstyles that you take despite there being a fairly impressive amount of pegs to place, perks to choose, and hurdles to avoid, but for all that there is to work with, Ballionaire feels like it steers you into those 5 set paths if you want to be successful. It does take a little while to get to that point, and the gameplay cycle of attempting a run, getting unlock tokens to add more pegs to your proverbial box-of-options, and going back in, is really solid and will absolutely eat hours of your life. As opposed to other rougelikes where your knowledge unlocks a whole new layer of understanding and satisfying mastery of the game, Ballionaire becomes fairly one-note instead. The journey to get to that point is not to be understated, I absolutely loved my time with Ballionaire and I still go back every-now-and-then but it's tail is not as long as I expected. Still a great game. Still an absolute dopamine milking machine. Cannot wait to see what the world of pachinko rougelikes holds.

Ballionaire is an unapologetically stylish dopamine-fueling Pachinko-styled Roguelite where you try to make enough of that sweet, sweet dough to impress the other ballers. If you've ever played a Roguelite or another game where you've created a "Proc-Chain," which is a term for when you activate one thing which then activates several other things in succession, you'll be right at home here. It is immensely satisfying to start with next to nothing and turn it into a nearly unstoppable tide of balls going up and down the screen (my personal style is flipping gravity over and over). On top of that, there's plenty of variety in progressive unlocks, levels, and difficulties to keep you here for hours depending on level of self-diagnosed ADHD. My sole complaint of the game is the audio balancing. Certain sounds are significantly louder than others. This IS solved just by turning the sound FX down a bit, but I find myself adjusting the slider back and forth often enough that I consider it to be an issue. That having been said, the game is exactly what you see on the tin, and chances are that if you think you'll like it, you absolutely will.
